pred observation_kept(issue,source) : cognition.

pred candidate(issue,reason) : cognition.

pred accepted_report(issue,reason,source) : cognition.
pred clarification_opportunity(issue) : cognition.
pred clarification_asked(issue) : cognition.
pred interruption_budget : cognition.
pred promise(task,trigger) : cognition.
pred rebind(task,trigger,trigger) : cognition.
pred trigger_observed(trigger) : cognition.
pred ready(task) : cognition.
pred notified(task) : cognition.
pred fulfilled(task) : cognition.
pred completion_report(task) : cognition.
pred consented_plan(task,plan) : cognition.
pred change_consent(task,plan) : cognition.
pred changed_circumstances(task) : cognition.
pred reconsideration_offered(task) : cognition.
stage live {
  %% [B01-C02-S01, B01-C04-S01] "There were several possible explanations."
  %% Nina retains the observed discrepancy and considers two possible explanations; neither is established as true.
  consider [story] : discrepancy(I,S) * open_issue(I) * alternatives(I,A,B)
    -o observation_kept(I,S) * considering(I) * candidate(I,A) * candidate(I,B).
  %% [B01-C02-S01, B01-C04-S01] "Busy morning?"
  %% Given an explicit opportunity, Nina spends one available interruption to ask for clarification, before certainty.
  clarify [story] : $considering(I) * clarification_opportunity(I) * interruption_budget
    -o clarification_asked(I).
  %% [B01-C02-S02, B01-C04-S02] "What had changed was the explanation connecting them."
  %% Nina accepts a sourced report as her current explanation; she retains the observations, not certainty about hidden truth.
  accept_report [story] : considering(I) * candidate(I,R) * explanation_report(I,R,S)
    -o accepted_report(I,R,S).
  %% [B01-C01-S03] "It belonged to a future event: his return."
  %% At the resident's instruction, Nina changes a promise's trigger, preserving the promise itself.
  rebind_promise [story] : promise(T,A) * rebind(T,A,B) -o promise(T,B).
  %% [B01-C01-S03] "It belonged to a future event: his return."
  %% A reported trigger makes its promised reminder ready; a notification has not yet happened.
  make_ready [story] : promise(T,E) * $trigger_observed(E) -o ready(T).
  %% [B01-C01-S02, B01-C06-S01] "At five forty-five, she mentioned it."
  %% Nina spends one interruption opportunity to remind the resident about task T. Notification does not fulfill the task.
  remind [story] : ready(T) * interruption_budget -o notified(T).
  %% [B01-C08-S02] "an activity he had already completed."
  %% A human completion report closes a still-scheduled promise without delivering an obsolete reminder.
  reconcile_scheduled [story] : promise(T,E) * completion_report(T) -o fulfilled(T).
  %% [B01-C08-S02] "an activity he had already completed."
  %% A human completion report closes a ready promise before any notification.
  reconcile_ready [story] : ready(T) * completion_report(T) -o fulfilled(T).
  %% [B01-C08-S02] "an activity he had already completed."
  %% A human completion report closes an already-notified task; the earlier reminder alone did not establish completion.
  reconcile_notified [story] : notified(T) * completion_report(T) -o fulfilled(T).
  %% [B01-C06-S02] "Do it."
  %% Explicit fresh consent changes the selected plan. Changed circumstances alone grant no such permission.
  change_plan [story] : consented_plan(T,A) * change_consent(T,B) -o consented_plan(T,B).
  %% [B01-C06-S03] "A changed circumstance did not automatically cancel a decision"
  %% Changed circumstances can prompt reconsideration while preserving the consented plan.
  reconsider [story] : $consented_plan(T,A) * changed_circumstances(T) -o reconsideration_offered(T).
}
